summary: The rendered output captures some core letter text and key metadata, but it has several major fidelity problems: missing logo and QR placeholders, misplaced/misrepresented seal, missing recipient campus line, likely duplicated body wording, missing signature-area stamp placeholder, and missing footer contact information. The overall structure is recognizable but not sufficiently faithful to the source.
matches_well: Main campus name is present in Nepali and English.
Reference number is captured essentially correctly.
Date value is captured, though formatted with slashes rather than the source separators.
The signatory name “प्रा. डा. नीलम श्रेष्ठ प्रधान” and designation “क्याम्पस प्रमुख” are present.
The copied-to section includes the three intended recipients.

discrepancies.source_observation: A triangular logo/emblem appears at the upper left of the letterhead.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: No placeholder is shown for the triangular Tribhuvan University/campus logo.

discrepancies.source_observation: A QR code appears near the phone number at the upper right.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: No placeholder is shown for the QR code.

discrepancies.source_observation: The round office seal appears lower, around the area below the establishment line and above the body, not covering the main campus title.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: A large circular placeholder labeled “Office Seal” is placed over/near the main title.

discrepancies.source_observation: This text is centered above the main campus name in the letterhead.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The “त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय / Tribhuvan University” text is placed at the far upper left.
The rendered establishment text appears different from the source wording.

discrepancies.source_observation: The recipient block includes three lines: “श्री यसोदा कुमारी भट्ट जोशी”, “समाजशास्त्र विभाग”, and “त्रि-चन्द्र बहुमुखी क्याम्पस ।”
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The recipient block includes “श्री यसोदा कुमारी भट्ट जोशी समाजशास्त्र विभाग” but omits the campus line.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source states “आंशिक शिक्षकमा नियुक्त गरिएको छ ।” without duplicated “गरिएको”.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The body text appears to contain duplicated wording around “नियुक्त गरिएको गरिएको छ”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source has a signature plus an official stamp below/near the designation reading as the campus chief stamp for Tri-Chandra Multiple Campus.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Only a signature placeholder and typed name/designation are present; no separate placeholder for the office stamp near the signature is shown.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source uses only Nepali numbering: “१)”, “२)”, “३)”.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Each list item has duplicate numbering, e.g. “1) १)”, “2) २)”, “3) ३)”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source formats the copied-to section with line breaks under each numbered item.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The addressee lines in the copied-to section are flattened into single lines.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source footer includes a horizontal line plus “Email: info@trc.tu.edu.np” and “Website: https://trc.tu.edu.np”.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The footer line, email address, and website are missing.

discrepancies.source_observation: A faint clock-tower watermark appears in the center of the source page.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The central clock-tower watermark/background image is not represented.
